title: Microsoft Purview classifiers: what recognises sensitive content, and who controls it?
summary: Hold: the page says a published custom classifier can be used in Communication Compliance, although Microsoft explicitly excludes custom classifiers. It also generalises a trainable-classifier encryption limitation to all classifiers, omits restrictions on seed folders, and gives an unverified account of what pausing on-demand classification does.

claims.claim: Encrypted items cannot be classified by Purview classifiers generally.

claims.fix: Replace the entire bullet with '**Trainable classifiers only work with unencrypted items.** Microsoft states this limitation on its trainable-classifier page.' The cited trainable-classifier limitation does not establish a prohibition for all classifier types or all encryption scenarios.
